steps.title: a / an, the, and no article
steps.html:
UseWhenExample
a / anone thing, mentioned for the first timeThere's a fridge in the kitchen.
thewe both know which oneThe fridge is next to the window.
thethere is only onethe centre of the city, the East River
no articleplural or generalI like flats with big windows.
no articlecities, countries, streetsShe lives in Almaty, on Abay Street.

an goes before a vowel sound: an armchair, an old building.

The first time you name something, use a. After that, use the.

Learners often add the before plural general nouns. I like the flats means specific flats we both know.

steps.title: You are looking at flats online.
steps.sub: What is usually different between the photo and the real flat?

steps.title: 1 · The advert
steps.html:
BRIGHT STUDIO IN THE CENTRE — $800

A cosy studio flat on the 4th floor of a modern building. There is a new kitchen with a fridge and a cooker. There is a big window with a beautiful view of the river. The building is next to a restaurant and opposite a garage, so everything is close. A perfect first flat for a young professional. Call today!

steps.title: 2 · The tenant
steps.html:
I live in the studio in the photo. It's true: the rent is $800 and the view is beautiful. But there is only one room. I cook, eat, relax and sleep in the same place. My bed is on a shelf above the kitchen, and the shower is under the shelf.

There isn't a dishwasher and there isn't a washing machine, so I go to the launderette on Grand Street. There isn't a lift either — the 4th floor is four floors of stairs. The garage is open 24 hours, so the street is never quiet. And I love it.
